The OIG data set does not contain scheduled inspection dates for individual facilities. It reports past inspections and current open recommendations, but it does not include any “next‑due” inspection calendar for the VA El Paso Healthcare System (or any other VA location). Therefore, a specific future inspection date cannot be provided from the available OIG information.
